name: smartwork360
description: SMARTWORK 360 — AI + Blockchain-backed Smart Task & Performance Management System for Government Offices

scripts.build: npm run build -w @smartwork/shared && npm run build -w @smartwork/api && npm run build -w @smartwork/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @smartwork/api" "npm run dev -w @smartwork/web"
scripts.dev:ml: cd services/ml && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt && ./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @smartwork/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @smartwork/shared && npm run typecheck -w @smartwork/api && npm run typecheck -w @smartwork/web
